title: BrokerJobSubmit
description: Schema for job payloads submitted to the Hermes-OpenClaw broker via the broker_submit_job tool. Only the Hermes supervisor (main-hermes) may submit jobs. The broker validates this schema before spawning or routing to any worker runtime.

job_id.description: Unique identifier for this job. UUIDv4. Generated by Hermes before submission.

correlation_id.description: Links this job to a parent intent, handoff, or supervisor run. Required for audit trail.

submitted_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of job submission.

submitted_by.description: Must be 'main-hermes'. Broker rejects submissions from any other agent.

worker.description: Target worker agent ID. Must match a registered agent in config/stack.yaml.

runtime.description: Execution runtime for the worker. Must match the worker's configured runtime in config/stack.yaml.

mode.description: Optional mode hint passed to the worker. Must be a valid mode for the target worker (e.g. 'refresh', 'bootstrap', 'drift-from-research'). Validated against shared/tools.yaml agent mode lists.

objective.description: Clear, scoped task objective passed to the worker. Plain language. Not a system prompt.

allowed_capabilities.description: Explicit list of tool keys the worker is permitted to use for this job. Must be a subset of the worker's tools list in config/stack.yaml. Broker enforces this at runtime.

workspace.description: Workspace mount configuration for the worker session.

job_dir.description: Dedicated job directory. Worker writes artifacts here unless scoped to a named vault/room path.

read_paths.description: Additional paths the worker may read during this job. Merged with agent default read_scope.

write_paths.description: Additional paths the worker may write during this job. Merged with agent default write_scope. Broker enforces these at write time.

readonly_mounts.description: Paths mounted read-only into the worker session. Defaults include 'shared'.

inject_files.description: Files to inject into the worker session at startup (e.g. handoff document, context snapshot).

source_path.description: Path to source file in the workspace.

target_path.description: Path where the file is visible inside the worker session.

limits.description: Per-job resource and safety limits. Override agent defaults for this job only.

timeout_s.description: Job timeout in seconds. Broker kills the worker session if exceeded.

max_steps.description: Maximum agent steps (LLM calls + tool calls) allowed for this job.

budget_usd.description: Maximum LLM spend in USD for this job. Broker hard-stops the job if exceeded.

retries.description: Number of automatic retries on transient failure before escalating to Hermes.

max_parallel_tool_calls.description: Maximum concurrent tool calls allowed within this job.

network_access.description: Network access level for this job. 'none' disables all outbound calls. 'allowlisted' enforces shared/tools.yaml network_policy. 'full' requires explicit supervisor justification.

approval.description: Approval metadata for jobs requiring human or supervisor sign-off before execution.

required.description: Whether this job requires approval before the broker routes it to a worker.

approval_type.description: Who must approve: Hermes supervisor, a human operator, or a hard-gated human (treasury/ops).

approved.description: Set to true by the approving party. Broker will not start the job until this is true and required is true.

approved_by.description: Identity of the approving party (agent ID or human operator ID).

approval_notes.description: Optional notes from the approving party.

context.description: Optional structured context passed to the worker alongside the objective.

handoff_document_path.description: Path to a validated handoff document (e.g. build-intent, release-gate) relevant to this job.

handoff_schema.description: Schema key identifying the handoff document type.

parent_job_id.description: Job ID of a parent job this job depends on or follows from.

sprint_id.description: Optional sprint identifier for grouping related jobs in dashboards and audit logs.

tags.description: Free-form tags for routing, filtering, and audit queries.

extra.description: Arbitrary structured context for worker use. Must not contain secrets or credentials.

trace_context.description: W3C distributed trace context for OTEL span propagation from Hermes supervisor into worker execution.

tracestate.description: W3C tracestate header value. Optional vendor-specific trace state.

sandbox.description: Sandbox configuration overrides for this job. Broker applies these to the worker session.

non_root.description: Run worker process as non-root. Default true.

ephemeral.description: Destroy worker session on job completion. Default true for openclaw workers.

environment_vars.description: Explicit env vars to inject into the worker session. Values must be non-secret strings or references to allowed env var names.

deny_env_prefixes.description: Env var prefixes that must never be forwarded to this worker session.

examples.objective: Run a targeted refresh on OTEL trace propagation patterns in open-source agent frameworks. Produce findings and update the relevant dossier.
